# Fixtures for `protools_session`

Files made for whiff's tests, CC0-1.0, for the fictitious Saltmere Harbour. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/gaps5f.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `saltmere-shanty.ptx` | Pro Tools 12 session (scheme 5 obfuscation, little-endian) written from ptformat's block layout: sample rate, audio files, tracks, regions, MIDI tracks, a plug-in entry (craft_gaps5f.py) | CC0-1.0 |
| `saltmere-shanty-pt8.ptf` | the same as a Pro Tools 8 session (scheme 1, big-endian) | CC0-1.0 |
